description: MARKETPLACE offers from other users. If the user has not said whether they already arranged this trade with a specific person, ask first: "Have you already arranged this trade with a specific person, or should I look for offers from other users on the iEscrow marketplace?" With a counterparty of their own these offers are not what they need: a private trade with that person is opened from their iEscrow account. Best live offers on the iEscrow marketplace to swap one crypto for another, for the given amount. Both legs are held in escrow, so there is no payment account and no bank involved. The platform fee is charged on EACH leg separately, so the reply states what the user would deliver fee included and what they would receive net. Give either give_amount or get_amount, not both. No account needed to look; taking an offer needs an iEscrow account. For crypto against government money use get_quote instead.

get_amount.description: Amount the user wants to receive. Give this OR give_amount.

get_currency.description: Crypto the user receives, e.g. BTC. Needed for a quote.

give_amount.description: Amount the user wants to deliver. Give this OR get_amount. Without any amount the answer is the market rate and how many offers exist for the pair.

give_currency.description: Crypto the user delivers, e.g. USDT. Needed for a quote; without it the answer lists the cryptos that can be quoted.

limit.description: How many offers to return, 1 to 20.

name: get_swap_quote
title: Live offers to swap one crypto for another
